title: Entertainer David Bowie and the Berlin Wall
main_content:
David Bowie is a British singer/songwriter who remains one of the recognizable singers in the world of pop/rock music.

Beginning in the late 1960s and continuing through the 1980s, his music was edgy and experimental.

Many of Bowie’s albums and concerts featured strangely dressed characters, like Ziggy Stardust and The Thin White Duke. These characters allowed him to experiment and to create unusual music for that time.

On June 7, 1987, David Bowie returned to then-West Berlin to perform a concert close to the Berlin Wall.

“We send our wishes to all our friends who are on the other side of the wall,” he said in German. Reportedly, East Germans gathered to listen to the concert on the other side of the wall.

Bowie then sang the song Heroes, a song he had written in the capital. The song Heroes is about the Cold War and about the divided city of Berlin. Crowds on the other side of the Berlin Wall in East Germany cheered.

Weeks later then – U.S. President Ronald Reagan made his now-famous speech.

(Here is a portion of the lyrics referring to the Berlin Wall.)

I, I can remember (I remember) Standing, by the wall (by the wall) And the guns shot above our heads (over our heads) And we kissed, as though nothing could fall (nothing could fall) And the shame was on the other side Oh we can beat them, for ever and ever Then we could be Heroes, just for one day

questions.question: Who is David Bowie?
options: A renowned British poet known for his literary works
A British painter celebrated for his abstract art
A British singer/songwriter recognized in pop/rock music
A film director famous for his avant-garde movies
questions.answer: A British singer/songwriter recognized in pop/rock music

questions.question: When did David Bowie return to then-West Berlin to perform a concert close to the Berlin Wall?
What is the song Heroes about?
options: The Cold War and the divided city of Berlin
The life of David Bowie in London
The unification of Germany after World War II
The struggles of artists in the music industry
questions.answer: The Cold War and the divided city of Berlin
